title: Time-and-Materials Rate Card — Professional Services Projects
content:
This rate card gives the hourly rates and time-and-materials terms of Professional Services Projects for each engagement class. The rates are list rates per hour of logged time.

| Figure | Assessment Engagement | Quick Start Project | Standard Project | Advanced Project | Major Project | Strategic Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Technician, USD per hour | 165.00 | 165.00 | 160.00 | 155.00 | 150.00 | 145.00 |
| Senior engineer, USD per hour | 195.00 | 195.00 | 190.00 | 185.00 | 180.00 | 175.00 |
| Solutions architect, USD per hour | 245.00 | 245.00 | 240.00 | 230.00 | 220.00 | 210.00 |
| Multiplier on the hourly rate for work in a scheduled after-hours window | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 |
| Increment logged minutes are rounded up to (minutes) | 30 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Minimum billable hours per onsite day on time-and-materials work | 4 | 4 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| ClearPath rate discount (percent) | 0.0 | 5.0 | 5.0 | 7.5 | 7.5 | 10.0 |
| Lowest ClearPath tier rank that earns the rate discount (rank 1 to 6) | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Time-and-materials work may be drawn from an eligible prepaid TimeBank block | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Share of the not-to-exceed amount consumed at which the client is notified (percent) | 80 | 80 | 80 | 85 | 85 | 90 |
| Work beyond the not-to-exceed amount may be billed without a signed change order | no | no | no | no | no | no |

## What the rows mean

- The ClearPath rate discount is the discount off time-and-materials rates for clients holding an active ClearPath agreement at or above the lowest ClearPath tier rank that earns the rate discount at signature (percent).
- The rounding increment applies to logged minutes, which are always rounded up to it.
- The after-hours multiplier applies only to work in a scheduled after-hours window; work inside business hours carries no multiplier.

Hypothetical illustration: on the Standard Project card, an hour of senior engineer time is listed at 190.00 and an hour of the same work in a scheduled after-hours window at 1.5 times that rate.
